description: Group pool funding (实缴池 = group subject wallet balance) and member pledge/cap usage (认缴 = SUM(group_member_billing.cap_credits)). NOTE: there is no dedicated pledge/pool table in the schema; this is reconstructed from subject_wallets (group subjects) + group_member_billing. See README caveats.

panels.description: 实缴池: total credits sitting in group-subject wallets (subjects.subject_type = 'group').
panels.title: Group pool funded balance (实缴池)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.balance_credits), 0) AS group_pool_balance
FROM pendingbot.subject_wallets w
JOIN pendingbot.subjects s ON s.id = w.subject_id
WHERE s.subject_type = 'group';

panels.description: 认缴: sum of per-member spend caps across all groups (group_member_billing.cap_credits; NULL cap = uncapped, excluded from this sum).
panels.title: Pledged member caps (认缴)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cap_credits), 0) AS pledged_caps
FROM pendingbot.group_member_billing
WHERE participates = true
  AND cap_credits IS NOT NULL;

panels.description: Alert-friendly: pledge usage rate = SUM(spent_credits) / SUM(cap_credits) across capped, participating members. >100% means caps overspent in aggregate.
panels.title: Pledge usage rate (认缴使用率)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN COALESCE(SUM(cap_credits), 0) = 0 THEN 0
  ELSE SUM(spent_credits)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(cap_credits), 0)
END AS pledge_usage_rate
FROM pendingbot.group_member_billing
WHERE participates = true
  AND cap_credits IS NOT NULL;

panels.description: Per-group pool: funded balance, member count, total spent, total capped, usage rate. Highest usage first.
panels.title: Per-group pool usage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  gmb.conversation_id,
  c.title AS group_title,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gmb.participates) AS participating_members,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gmb.overdrawn) AS overdrawn_members,
  COALESCE(SUM(gmb.spent_credits), 0) AS total_spent,
  COALESCE(SUM(gmb.cap_credits), 0) AS total_capped,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(gmb.cap_credits), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(SUM(gmb.spent_credits)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(gmb.cap_credits), 0), 4)
  END AS usage_rate
FROM pendingbot.group_member_billing gmb
LEFT JOIN pendingbot.conversations c ON c.id = gmb.conversation_id
GROUP BY gmb.conversation_id, c.title
ORDER BY usage_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200;

title: PendingBot — Group Pool & Pledge
